links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of chatbot answers to anaesthesia patient FAQs
links.effect: Accuracy score of ≥4 given by 58%, 48%, and 36% of experts for ChatGPT4, Bard, and Bing Chat respectively; all performed poorly in accuracy.
links.quote: All AI chatbots performed poorly in accuracy (score of ≥4 by 58%, 48%, and 36% of experts for ChatGPT4, Bard, and Bing Chat, respectively), comprehensiveness (score ≥4 by 42%, 30%, and 12% of experts for ChatGPT4, Bard, and Bing Chat, respectively), and safety (score ≥4 by 50%, 40%, and 28% of experts for ChatGPT4, Bard, and Bing Chat, respectively).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots answering frequently asked anaesthesia questions for patients, scored by expert residency programme directors on safety, accuracy, and communication quality.
